journey.title: Project
journey.description: We follow a systematic approach to transform your ideas into working technical solutions.

steps.title: Analysis & Engineering
steps.subtitle: Architecture & Consultation
items: Brainstorming session: Understanding project requirements, required functions, and technical constraints.
Technical feasibility study: Selecting the most suitable components (Hardware) and optimal programming languages (Software) to ensure highest performance at lowest cost.

steps.title: Digital Design & Modeling
steps.subtitle: Design Digital
items: Mechanical design: Building structures and parts using SolidWorks, considering strength and weight.
Electronic design: Drawing electrical circuits (PCB Design) and selecting sensors and controllers.
User interface design: (UX/UI) If the project includes screens or control applications.

steps.title: Software Development
steps.subtitle: Development Software
items: Embedded programming: (Embedded Systems) Writing code for controllers (Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi).
Algorithm programming: Integrating artificial intelligence or data processing if the project requires it.
Control application development: Connecting the project to mobile apps or computer programs.

steps.title: Manufacturing & Assembly
steps.subtitle: Assembly & Manufacturing
items: Digital manufacturing: Printing parts using 3D technology or laser cutting.
Engineering assembly: Installing mechanical parts, soldering circuits, and assembling the prototype.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Control
steps.subtitle: Control Quality & Testing
items: Stress testing: Ensuring the project withstands different working conditions.
System calibration: Adjusting sensors and software to achieve the required accuracy.

items.title: Complete Integration (One-in-All)
items.description: No need to search for a designer, programmer, and technician separately; we provide all specialties under one roof.

items.title: Technical Documentation
items.description: We deliver a complete file containing (schematics, source code, and operation manual).
